name: run_playtest
title: run_playtest
description: Launches the project in a separate Godot process and captures everything it prints — engine warnings, script errors, and GDScript stack traces — as structured diagnostics. This is the Observe stage: it is the only tool that tells you whether the game actually works, as opposed to whether it merely loads. The call returns as soon as the child process is up; the report arrives afterwards (inline for the in-editor agent, as a 'playtest_finished' event for an IPC client). Save the scene first — the child process reads the project from disk, not from the editor's unsaved state.

scene.description: Scene to run. Defaults to the project's configured main scene.

timeout_sec.description: How long to let it run before killing it. A game with no exit condition will always hit this; that is reported as 'timeout', not as a failure.

quit_after_frames.description: Shut the game down after N rendered frames (Godot's --quit-after). Use this for a deterministic smoke test instead of relying on the timeout — 120 frames is roughly two seconds of gameplay.

headless.description: Run with no window (--headless). Faster and works without a display, but nothing is drawn, so rendering bugs are invisible. Off by default because a human watching an agent work usually wants to see the game.

returns.description: Immediate launch acknowledgement. The report follows separately.

log_file.description: user:// path the child is writing its console output to.

outcome.description: clean = exited on its own with nothing logged; errors = ran but logged errors; crashed = non-zero exit; timeout = still running when the clock ran out.

diagnostics.description: Parsed errors and warnings, each with its source location where Godot reported one.

output_tail.description: Last lines of console output. When something goes wrong, what was printed just before it is usually what explains it.

errors.already_running: A playtest is in flight; stop it first.
errors.no_scene: No scene given and the project has no main scene configured.
errors.launch_failed: The editor could not spawn a Godot process.
